description: This PHP class defines a data transfer object (DTO) for filtering employment status searches within the OrangeHRM system. It extends a base FilterParams class and includes properties and methods to manage a 'name' filter and sorting behavior.

classes.name: EmploymentStatusSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A DTO for specifying search filters related to employment status, including filtering by name and default sorting by 'es.name'.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the filter parameters, setting default sort field to 'es.name'.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Retrieves the current value of the name filter.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the value for the name filter.
